External changes remain possible, hence repeated checks; this is an operational budget, not a memory guarantee.

frozen_device_refresh_design.after_lock_idle_scope: Only after common lock acquisition and parent compute-app cleanup, before GPU initialization. Query timeout and sleeps use remaining grace; fail RESOURCE_BLOCKED_NO_GPU_INITIALIZED if not confirmed. Never run this idle check before an episode because our own engine is then loaded. No resets, kills or concurrent-job changes.
